content:
Today, Instapaper launches version 10 of its iPhone and iPad apps, bringing multiple improvements and a major redesign of its web platform. Here are the details.

「逾十年來 iOS 應用程式最大更新」

Instapaper today announced (via MacMagazine) an update to its iOS app, while also adding new AI voice features to its Android app and completely overhauling its website.

Instapaper iOS version 10 adds support for the Liquid Glass design and introduces four reading fonts:

Literata: A serif font designed by Google for Google Play Books. New York: A serif font designed by Apple for iOS. Open Sans: A sans-serif font commissioned by Google. Atkinson Hyperlegible: A sans-serif font developed by the Braille Institute.

This update also adds Home Screen widgets, which Instapaper says can display the article you're currently reading as well as your most recently saved articles, while also serving as a one-tap shortcut to start reading.

Instapaper says that for iPad users, this update improves multitasking; meanwhile, both iPhone and iPad users will experience more reliable background syncing, faster article download speeds, and a redesigned onboarding walkthrough.

Instapaper says this update represents the largest set of changes in over a decade, which also includes:

Folder counts: All folders now display the number of articles or notes they contain. If you find folder counts add more anxiety than they help, you can disable this feature in "Settings > Behavior > Folder Counts". Folder sorting: To sort your folders or tags, tap the "…" menu next to the folder heading and select your preferred sort order. Article list appearance: We've introduced a compact view, new typography and styles, and an easy way to adjust the appearance of the article list. In the article list, tap "…" and then "Appearance" to adjust the style, font, and image thumbnails.

Finally, Instapaper has completely overhauled its web platform, adding features like a three-column reader and keyboard shortcuts, while the Android app has gained support for AI voice features.
